audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (a) The ultimate is written 'Chaaaaarge!' in whys[4], spikes[1], mid, late and wants.foe[2]; the real name is Chaaaaaaaarge!!! and it is 140/125/110s with a shield and a 3500-4500 range. (b) 'Beartrap' as one word in whys[0], whys[3], whys[5] and spikes[2] — the ability is Bear Trap on a Rope. (c) whys[1] credits Kled with a 'mounted Q3', which is Riven's ability, not his; and whys[2] says he 're-trades through dismount' when Riot's text says the opposite — dismounted, he deals less damage to champions.
audit.why: The dismount error is the one that costs games. Riven's job is to burn Skaarl and then finish, because that is the window where his damage is at its weakest — a page that tells the player he re-trades harder after dismounting tells her to disengage at exactly the moment she should be committing. Everything else on this page keys to cooldowns that were never written down: Q at 11/10/9/8/7, Jousting at 13/12/11/10/9 with a second cast back through the target, and Violent Tendencies at 13-to-9s for four fast attacks.
audit.corrected: Real name and 140s cooldown into whys[4]; Bear Trap on a Rope spelled correctly with its 800 range and 11s cooldown in whys[1], whys[3] and spikes[0].text; the phantom 'mounted Q3' replaced with Violent Tendencies' four-attack burst; whys[2] rewritten so dismount is the kill window, not his re-trade; the dismount damage reduction stated in report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither displacement interaction reached the page.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags two things. Both champions carry displacement — Riven's third Broken Wings knockback against Kled's Q yank — and whoever lands theirs first owns the trade, because the loser's cast is interrupted or repositioned out of range. And Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack reset, so his burst starts on the attack wind-up, not on a visible ability cast; a player watching for a cast animation steps back one attack too late.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0] rewritten around winning the displacement race; wants.foe[0] rewritten around the Violent Tendencies wind-up as the real tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t says to buy Executioner's Calling early because 'his healing fights your pattern'. Kled has no heal in his kit — restoring Skaarl's courage is a remount, not healing, and Grievous Wounds does not touch it.
audit.why: Sending the player to a Grievous Wounds component against a champion with no healing costs 800 gold of tempo in a lane whose whole plan is to spike first.
audit.corrected: Line rewritten to make the anti-heal conditional on him actually buying lifesteal.
